text:
maria: FYI — EchoMed received a surprise line on their renewal INV-9905 for a "hsm_integration_surcharge" after they converted to Private with HSM key management. Customer says HSM was quoted but not as a recurring surcharge. Invoice: https://invoices.internal/INV-9905 cc @josh

josh: I pulled the quote and signed SOW. SOW lists an HSM integration one-time professional fee of $25k, and a separate note 'ongoing HSM custodian surcharge applies if using hosted HSM service' but customer elected customer-managed HSM at deployment. Looks like billing system defaulted to hosted HSM surcharge erroneously.

elaine: Customer email: "we selected customer-managed KMS and did not agree to surcharge" sent 2026-10-12. They expect credit and correction of future invoices.

ravi: Invoice lines:
```
private_license        48,000.00   11/01/2026 - 10/31/2027
hsm_integration_surcharge  6,000.00  recurring annual
```
We need to determine whether surcharge is recurring or one-off setup. If their deployment used customer-managed keys, we should not charge recurring.

maria: Ops: can you confirm actual deployment mode? If they used customer-managed HSM but we billed hosted, that's on us. Attach infra provision logs. @josh

josh: Infra shows KMS provider set to "customer_hsm" in deployment record. No hosted HSM resources provisioned. Definitely a billing mapping bug.

elaine: Proposed remediation: 1) Issue full-year credit for the $6,000 recurring surcharge on INV-9905; 2) Update billing config to prevent future auto-surcharge; 3) Attach deployment logs and customer confirmation. Approvals needed for credits > $5k. @tara or finance exec please.

billing-bot: Credit proposal recorded: TICKET-HSM-411 amount: -6000.00 status: pending exec approval.

finance-bot: Quick check: material credit threshold for finance exec review is $5,000. This qualifies. Need one executive approval (Luke or CFO) and legal sign-off on memo wording.

tara: I can approve one-time remediation credit in cases of system error when infra shows customer-managed KMS. Approving $6,000 credit. GL: 4-120-SecurityCredits. Add audit note "HSM mapping error - EchoMed".

maria: Thanks. Will this be a credit memo applied to INV-9905 or a refund? Customer prefers credit.

josh: We'll apply credit memo. Also will remove recurring surcharge schedule and update product mapping rule. I'll open PROD ticket to change default behavior.

billing-bot: Creating adjustment: ADJ-15099 amount: -6000.00 status: pending posting. Attachments: infra logs link https://infra.internal/logs/deploy-8811 and customer email.

finance-bot: Reminder: post GL 4-120-SecurityCredits and ensure revenue ops adjusts ARR for the month. Also include clause "non-precedent remedial credit" per legal.

maria: Legal sign-off? @tara said approve; need legal to confirm memo text.

tara: Legal reviewed. Wording OK. Require attachment of customer confirmation email and infra log. Also put a clause asking customer to confirm in writing they used customer-managed KMS.

josh: Added customer email (2026-10-12) to ADJ. ADJ-15099 posted and applied to INV-9905. Amount: $6,000 credit. GL posted to 4-120-SecurityCredits. Link: https://billing.internal/adj/ADJ-15099. No refund.

maria: I'll update renewal reconciliation and the private-billing experiments dashboard to capture this HSM mapping failure. Josh please follow up on PROD ticket to prevent recurrence.

josh: PROD-804 created to default to no recurring HSM surcharge unless hosted_hsm resource present. I'll ping infra to get it prioritized.

elaine: Customer replied: "thank you for quick correction, please confirm future invoices won't include this charge." I replied with link to ADJ and confirmation and asked them to acknowledge deployment mode. Customer acknowledged. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
